purpose: 将每条非空原始来源交给 Qwen 做单来源知识消化，形成可读 Reader 页面；它不是原文复制，也不是质量案例的替代物。

route_verifier.purpose: separate provider-free source safety from post-provider semantic route verification; missing raw route labels do not block Qwen

pre_provider_producer.owner: R2 deterministic compiler; runs after Source→Block→Claim and before any Qwen request
deterministic_algorithm: parse only current raw bytes through the frozen Block/Claim parser; every row stores source_id, relative_path, source_content_hash, block/claim closure digest and raw coordinate map digest
classify only source safety and scope: present/non-empty, readable UTF-8, manifest identity equal, single-source request boundary, and supported/empty/duplicate status
do not use filename, directory, paragraph position or model output as proof of question, page type, product, module, object, scene or boundary
preserve a source with readable Claims even when route metadata is absent; only unreadable, unsafe, empty or duplicate states leave the Qwen Reader route
canonicalize source-scope rows with UTF-8 recursive key sorting and trailing LF; compute source_scope_ledger_sha256 before provider calls

rules: Qwen may generate question, title, page_type and product/module/object/scene/boundary labels only from the single-source Claim closure
every generated field must carry Claim/frame/locator support; page_type must be one of the five Reader types
top-level raw directory may be retained only as structural product route and filename only as display-title candidate
unsupported, ambiguous, stale or closure-external fields are Audit-only; they are not replaced with raw source text

derivation_rules.expected_title: Qwen chooses a readable title from the current single-source Claim closure; filename is only a display candidate
derivation_rules.question: Qwen chooses the reader question from the current single-source Claim closure; manifest question is prompt context, not proof
derivation_rules.page_type: Qwen chooses exactly one of positioning/concept/operation/diagnosis/experience and binds it to Claim/frame support
derivation_rules.axis: Qwen generates product/module/object/scene/boundary labels and binds each field to this source closure; top-level directory is structural product context only
derivation_rules.primary_intent: Qwen generates one primary reader intent from the source Claims; ambiguity or missing support is Audit-only

route_verifier.normalization: Unicode NFKC, trim outer whitespace, collapse internal ASCII whitespace only; preserve source locator bytes for verification
identity_checks: manifest source_id/path/content hash equals current source snapshot
every support ref belongs to this single source closure
recompute selected_source_closure_sha256 from current Block/Claim rows and producer frame rows
recompute support_sha256 from normalized candidate fields, ordered support refs and closure identity
typed Qwen fields are present, normalized and supported by this source closure
primary intent, page type and five axes are replayable from the typed output and Claim/frame locators
route_verifier.failure_status: pre-provider unsafe source => Audit-only and no Qwen; post-provider unsupported/ambiguous route => Audit-only; never raw fallback

structured_concept_exception.when: source-digest concept page with 30-59 supported Claims
structured_concept_exception.reason: preserve a structured named-field dictionary without forcing a lossy rewrite

large_dictionary_exception.when: source-digest concept page with at least 60 supported Claims
large_dictionary_exception.reason: preserve a complete large named configuration dictionary without falling back to raw source or Audit-only
